mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build a mother-in-law apartment?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to construct a mother-in-law apartment varies widely based on whether you are renovating an existing interior room, converting a garage, or building a brand-new detached structure. Major budget drivers include plumbing rough-ins for a new bathroom and kitchen, dedicated heating and cooling systems, separate electrical subpanels, and architectural finishes. Site conditions, utility connection distances, and foundation requirements also influence final estimates. Requesting an on-site consultation and detailed estimate helps define precise material allowances and labor costs before construction begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend heavily on project scope, utility tie-ins, bathroom plumbing, kitchen fixtures, and whether you convert existing space or build an addition from the ground up.
